summary: Iteration 14 — Comprehensive test of USDT TRC20 real-gateway top-up + 5-tab payment-methods UI + admin editor. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (payment-methods seeding/ordering/SVG assets, USDT create via real print8 gateway, invalid method/amount, status GET, notify unknown/bad-sign/valid-idempotent, legacy mock card instant credit). Frontend: desktop + mobile 375 both pass (5 tabs in a single row, correct filter counts, submit text swap, new tab opens pay_url on print8.8bc8uyz.com, pending panel with pay_amount+wallet_address, 關閉 hides panel). Admin: pm category select has usdt option, USDT edit shows base_url/api_key/api_secret/merchant_id crypto fields, PUT /api/admin/payment-methods/{id} with category=usdt returns 200.

verified_checks.usdt_create_order: POST /api/me/wallet/topup/usdt amount=10 → status=pending, out_trade_no=TU…, order_no, pay_amount=10.95 USDT, wallet_address=TYym52fJgZ…, pay_url=https://print8.8bc8uyz.com/pay/SF…, expires_at

verified_checks.frontend_desktop_1920: 5 tabs (all/usdt/card/ewallet/bank) visible; filter counts 5/1/1/2/1; selecting USDT changes submit text to '前往 USDT 收銀台'; clicking submit opens new tab with pay_url (https://print8.8bc8uyz.com/pay/SF…), pending panel shows pay_amount=10.95 USDT + wallet_address; 關閉 hides panel
verified_checks.frontend_mobile_375: pm-category-tabs single row (all y=734), rights 74→132→195→271→347 all ≤ 375 — no wrap, all visible without overflow
verified_checks.admin_crypto_fields: base_url, api_key, api_secret, merchant_id inputs present when editing USDT (provider=crypto)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L853: on gateway terminal statuses the DB is updated but _usdt_settle is not called for 'paid' here because that branch is handled separately — OK. The sentinel update sets t['status'] in memory but doesn't refresh other fields like paid_at; minor cosmetic.

server.py L873 hmac.compare_digest between hex str — safe. Note the server trusts gw-posted body['amount_usdt'] implicitly for _usdt_settle but the credited amount uses topup['amount_usd'] (local, pre-stored), so a malicious short-pay cannot credit extra. Good.

server.py L826 APP_PUBLIC_URL fallback to request Origin header: a crafted Origin from the client could manipulate the notify_url the gateway stores. Low risk in a trusted env but worth noting — recommend requiring APP_PUBLIC_URL in production.
WalletTopUp.jsx L55 win.location.href assignment after awaited call: if backend takes >1-2s, the blank popup may be blocked by some browsers' popup heuristics. Works in current test with Chromium.
